title: 第9章 药老萧火火林玄被盯上了第10章 本小姐要把他扒个精光
content_zh:
这种丹药一旦让人看到，必定招来麻烦！
所以，剩下的两颗丹药，他决定收敛一点，不要搞得太夸张。
但在那之前，他要先炼化掉这三颗黄阶四品金纹丹药。
“来吧！”
林玄开始炼化四道金纹的玄气丹。
它的药力，果然比三道丹药更强，更持久。
但因为他的境界已经达到玄气境二层，炼化的时间反而快了一点。
两颗丹药炼化完毕，他的境界如愿达到了玄气境三层！
“不出所料，提升一阶，需要两倍起步的丹药。”
照此估算，进阶到玄气境四层，至少需要四颗同级别的丹药！
这次进阶的动静有些大，若非他及时收敛，恐怕已经惊动了旁人。
这也给他提了一个醒，下次进阶，要找一处稳妥的地方了。
不能过早暴露实力。
“继续炼丹！”
林玄祭出天地洪炉，开始修复最后两颗丹药。
修为达到玄气境三层之后，他体内的玄气再次暴涨。
对天地洪炉的掌控也越发熟练，但他并不打算全力祭炼这两颗丹药，要收敛克制一些。
只要达到正常玄气丹的水准就好。
至于丹纹，肯定不能是金色的，否则拿出去会惹出麻烦。
三个呼吸之后，丹药修复完毕。

盖子打开，药香飘出，比刚才的淡了很多。
林玄拿出一看，神色却有些古怪。
这一次没有金色丹纹，也没有三道或者四道丹纹。
却仍有一道丹纹，呈现青色！
林玄捏了捏眉心，不禁苦笑。
天地洪炉的威力还是太强了，哪怕他极力克制，炼制出的丹药仍然达到了黄阶一品青纹的级别。
相比天玄宗正常炼制的丹药，仍然好了太多。
这也让他打消了向同门出售的心思。
他在天玄宗“名气”很大，身份藏不住。
这种丹药一旦暴露，会引来许多不必要的麻烦。
而他很快想到了丹药的理想去处。
content_en:
Once this kind of elixir is seen, it will definitely cause trouble!
Therefore, for the remaining two pills, he decided to restrain himself a little and not be too exaggerated.
But before that, he had to refine these three yellow-level fourth-grade gold-patterned elixirs.
"Come on!"
Lin Xuan began to refine the Xuanqi Pill with four golden patterns.
Its medicinal power is indeed stronger and more lasting than the three pills.
But because his realm has reached the second level of Xuan Qi Realm, the refining time is a little faster.
After the two elixirs were refined, his realm reached the third level of Xuanqi realm as expected!
"As expected, to advance to one level, you need twice the amount of pills you started with."
According to this estimate, at least four pills of the same level are needed to advance to the fourth level of the Xuan Qi Realm!
The noise of this advancement was a bit loud. If he hadn't restrained himself in time, he might have alerted others.
This also reminded him that he should find a safe place to advance next time.
Don't expose your strength too early.
"Continue making alchemy!"
Lin Xuan sacrificed the Heaven and Earth Furnace and began to repair the last two pills.
After reaching the third level of Xuanqi Realm, the Xuanqi in his body skyrocketed again.
He is also becoming more and more proficient in controlling the Heaven and Earth Furnace, but he does not intend to go all out to refine these two elixirs and needs to be more restrained.
As long as it reaches the level of normal Xuan Qi Dan.
As for the elixir pattern, it must not be golden, otherwise it will cause trouble if you take it out.
After three breaths, the elixir was repaired.
When the lid was opened, the medicinal fragrance floated out, which was much lighter than before.
Lin Xuan took it out and looked at it, but his expression was a little strange.
This time there are no golden elixir patterns, nor are there three or four elixir patterns.
But there is still a pill pattern, showing a cyan color!
Lin Xuan pinched his eyebrows and couldn't help but smile bitterly.
The power of the Heaven and Earth Furnace was still too strong. Even if he tried his best to restrain it, the elixir he refined still reached the level of Yellow Rank First Grade Blue Mark.
Compared with the elixirs normally refined by Tianxuan Sect, it is still much better.
This also made him give up the idea of ​​selling to his fellow students.
He is very "famous" in Tianxuan Sect and his identity cannot be hidden.
Once this kind of elixir is exposed, it will cause a lot of unnecessary trouble.
And he quickly thought of the ideal place for the elixir.
